title.narrative: Cameroon SCH/STH Far North Region

description.narrative: The project aim is to have a significant drop in the prevalence of both Schistosomiasis (SCH) and Soil Transmitted Helminths (STH) through a yearly Mass Drug Administration of Mebendazole and Praziquantel in endemic areas. It is expected that morbidity resulting from SCH/STH infection will be reduced to a post intervention level of < 1% in 3 years, as per WHO elimination target. The project will strengthen the national programme against SCH/STH by ensuring Mass drug administration and supporting some Social Behaviour Change Communication (SBCC) activities in areas with high Schistosomiasis prevalence. Improved hygiene practices at individual and community levels will contribute to maintain low transmission of the diseases.
